"Question Explanation : In this question we are given the rate of flow of bivalent positive ions (moving right) and monovalent negative ions (moving left). We need to find the net current and direction.

Concept : This question is based on electric current due to flow of ions.

Solution : For ions, current due to cations and anions adds algebraically. Each bivalent positive ion has charge +2e. Each monovalent negative ion has charge –e
I = Ne (N = number of ions/second)
Given here
Positive ions = 3.2 × 1018 / second, charge = +2e
Negative ions = 3.6 × 1018/ second, charge = –e
(e = 1.6 × 10–19 C)
∴ Inet = I+ + I–
Inet = (3.2 × 1018 × 2e) + (3.6 × 1018 ×e)
Inet = e(6.4 × 1018 + 3.6 × 1018)
Inet = e(6.4 + 3.6) × 1018
Inet = 1.6 × 10–19 × 10 × 1018
Inet = 1.6 A to the right
Note : Current due to negative ions moving left is in the same direction as positive ions moving right.

Final answer : Option (2)"
